findings.statement: The patient is a 63-year-old male with a history of pancreatic adenocarcinoma (AJCC Stage III) who experienced disease recurrence 24 months post-initial treatment. Clinical data documents disease progression at age 62.608 years with rising CA 19-9 levels (up to 36,658 Units/ml) and cessation of chemotherapy at age 62.896 years. The available clinical timeline ends at age 63 years, with no subsequent survival or mortality data provided.
